summary: HIVE Digital Technologies filed a Form 8-K on September 16, 2026, reporting two items dated September 10, 2026. Under Item 7.01, the company furnished a press release with business and operating updates. Under Item 8.01, it disclosed that wholly owned subsidiary BUZZ High Performance Computing Inc. appointed Mark Volk as Senior Vice President, Revenue, and that preliminary estimated average daily revenue exceeded roughly USD$1 million from combined hashrate and GPU services. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated; figures are unaudited and not a forecast. Watch for operational follow-through, not deal terms.
